targets.title: Attitudinal, normative, and resource factors affecting psychologists’ intentions to adopt an open data badge: An empirical analysis.
targets.evidence_quote:
Grounded in the theoretical framework of the TPB, we focused our study on replicating the research design
of Harper and Kim (2018) and evaluating their hypotheses in the context of Chinese communication
scholars.
targets.outcome_quote:
However, our study found different results regarding perceived effort. Harper and Kim (2018) claimed that
perceived effort negatively affected individuals’ behavioral intentions but did not influence their attitudes.
In contrast, our results suggested that perceived effort negatively affected individuals’ attitudes (𝛽 = −.159,
𝑝 < .001) but had no significant impact on behavioral intentions (𝛽 = −.022, 𝑝 > .05).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit agreement for benefit, risk, and norms; explicit disagreement for effort, journal pressure, and facilitating conditions. No overall verdict supersedes these comparisons.

reasoning: New survey sample of Chinese communication scholars retests the hypotheses from one earlier paper. Theory and instrument/background references are not targets.
